若 packet.continuation.scope=calendar，只处理日历：decisions=[]，保留当前 archiveTitle，不修改新闻、tracking、期号或窗口。按 pinned pages 的完整身份提交 calendarReview 和已核实 upcoming/removeUpcomingIds；部分核验仍显式 deferred，GitHub 保留队列重试。使用同一期单 inbox，不与新闻组成 bundle。
若 editorialInput.calendarWork 存在，upcomingDiscovery 只是预览；必须按 calendarWork.pages 中的 blobSha 读取完整分页（automation/state 分支 automation/batches/<edition-id>/<name>）。calendarReview.pages 对每个 blobSha、calendarReview.platforms 对 PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Nintendo 各给一个 key/status/reason；status 只能 reviewed 或 deferred，reason 记录实际核验或具体阻塞。未读完不能声称 reviewed；延期必须显式保留。分页只提供日历线索，采用前仍须打开官方详情核验。
发布会条目须用coveredFactIds登记正文或简讯实际覆盖的showcaseFacts；同一页面、同一游戏不等于全部事实已覆盖。只有存在会改变正文事实边界的实质证据缺口才继续needs_review，不因热度或预算排除，也不要把needs_review当作默认保守选项。
输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。
从 automation/status/<edition-id>.json 原样复制 packet.blobSha 到 packetBlobSha；不得使用可变分支 HEAD。publishability=requires_subject_identity 只能 exclude/needs_review，不得从标题虚构 titleKey/titleEn。
若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。
证据门槛按最终 factStatus 判断，不按来源数量机械升级：official 要求已打开一手来源；单一已打开、注册为 media 的可信媒体，只要主体、窗口和核心事实清楚，就可以 media_report 发布，不得仅因“只有一家媒体”或 readiness=single-media 而 needs_review；可信媒体明确转述可识别的官方公告、采访或发言时，可以 media_relay_official，verification 写清转述链。multi_source_verified 才要求两家独立可靠来源。readiness 只描述证据组成，不是发布资格。未确认但具有新闻价值且来源边界清楚的内容可进 rumors，factStatus=unconfirmed、tracking=true，并在标题摘要保留不确定性；只有主体身份未解、来源互相冲突、固定窗口无法确认、动态聚合数据缺少所需快照等实质阻塞才使用 needs_review。A级也不豁免时间/来源要求。中英文新闻标题和archiveTitle须自带明确的游戏、公司或人物主语，离开上方主体栏仍能独立理解。中文直述具体事实，verification 说明证据边界，不用宣传套话。
每个 include 决定必须填写完整 sharedFactFrame，作为两种语言共用的事实边界；subjectTitleKey/platforms 必须与最终 Canonical 决定一致，日期、时刻、数字、人物机构、版本专名只能来自所选证据，不得新增。
中文游戏名依次查 config/title-translations.json、editorialInput.titleHints，仍缺才做 title-only open-web lookup。优先官方简中，其次已查证广泛使用的 common_translation；否则保留原名，titleZhCn=null、titleZhStatus=unavailable。禁止机翻/自造名称。有官方大陆简中渠道的游戏，版本、角色、职业、模式、机制等采用大陆官方术语。所有名称/术语查询仅规范名称，不得增加事件事实、时间、平台、发行信息、来源分类、tracking 或候选。

packages.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – Kill Block is Must-Play Multiplayer at Launch

sources.label: Xbox Wire
sources.evidenceText:
With its global launch today, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 brings a brand-new Multiplayer mode that’s sure to keep us on our toes for months to come.
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – Kill Block is Must-Play Multiplayer at Launch
Hidden inside the West Bridge Advanced Military Training Facility is a complex combat environment where shifting, modular battlegrounds challenge even the most elite Operators, with hundreds of unique configurations. This is Kill Block, and if you’re picking up Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 today, you must play it – it’s one of the most inventive and fun maps to come to Call of Duty Multiplayer in years.
As noted on the Call of Duty Blog , most map sections are entirely new, while others draw inspiration from iconic locations across Modern Warfare history. More than 500 configurations are possible at launch, with layouts changing between matches and throughout rounds to transform cover placement and pacing, supporting both 3v3 and the new 10v10 Gunfight mode at launch, with future support planned for more core Multiplayer modes. It’s an ever-changing map that enables teams to experience a variety of environments across numerous combat scenarios.
I got a taste of Kill Block last month during the Modern Warfare 4 Beta and found this constant cycle of combat a refreshing challenge – having to adapt to a changing map between rounds made it feel like teams were on an even footing, each trying to make note of corners and discover ideal spots to post up on defense as quickly as possible. And now with its wide release today for the launch of Modern Warfare 4 , I can’t wait to dive back in.
One of the strategies I employed during my hands-on time was to get familiar with the Central Slab first. Because those are always linked with the adjacent slabs, the central area of the map would typically offer scenery crafted to enhance combat coming in from multiple angles – these were almost always the primary encounter points against other teams to rack up eliminations. While it’s tempting to try and rush through and get a sense of the entire randomly generated layout, focusing on the Central Slab and working out from there was usually an ideal strategy I found.
Another observation is that each of the Slabs are rectangular in shape, and often a familiar footprint; self-contained, but with the necessary openings to allow for effective match flow into adjacent Slabs. And there was almost always an opportunity for cover, like parked trucks, burned-out tanks and cars, concrete blocks, barriers, and walls, and a few tactically important doors you can shoot open, barge through or open slowly with stealth in mind. There’s also plenty of markers to take note of to jog your memory if you’ve played through a Slab before, so make sure you take mental notes for construction signs, grenade marks, arrows, numbers, and others to assist in your spatial awareness as you learn the environments.
As touched on earlier, the Call of Duty Blog confirmed that while most Slabs are entirely new, others recreate iconic locations including Crash from Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (2007) , Storage Town from Call of Duty: Warzone ’s Verdansk map, and Shoot House from Modern Warfare (2019) . Though drawn from iconic maps, these Slabs are fundamentally changed by the randomized areas around them, allowing for terrain to deliver both classic and new tactical experiences, which is going to be a lot of fun.
The way it works is this: Kill Block is a Multiplayer map that reconfigures every match, challenging you to rethink routes, sightlines, and combat spaces on the fly. And right when you think you’ve got it figured out, the Slabs switch again.

packages.headline: Saros: creating the epic Overlords of Carcosa

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
Nixxes shares insights on co-developing Saros with Housemarque.
Saros: creating the epic Overlords of Carcosa
Housemarque and Nixxes developed Saros in close collaboration; one area was developing the set-piece bosses. Housemarque brought the creative vision, world, combat language, visual concepts, and signature bullet-hell DNA. Nixxes brought the bosses to life through encounter design, animation, environments, lighting, and technical implementation.
The result was a set of encounters designed to challenge players, surprise them, and deliver the kind of spectacle PlayStation players expect from a Housemarque action experience. Spoilers for the bosses of Saros ahead, so read at your own risk.
Boss fights in Saros are fully staged encounters, not just enemies with larger health bars, so that required close collaboration from the start. Housemarque handled boss concepts, visual direction, and VFX identity. Nixxes focused on animation, environments, technical design, boss behaviour, and attack implementation, with Housemarque’s final review and collaboration.
When designing bosses for Saros, we followed a few guiding principles, starting with three distinct phases for every boss encounter, each with its own identity, changing how the encounter looks, feels, and plays.
A typical boss battle in Saros lasts about three to eight minutes (Saros: Zenith has a tighter arcade experience), with the challenge coming mainly from boss behaviour, arena transformation, environmental hazards, bullets, beams, and physical attacks. These were also designed to encourage players to use their shield, jumping, parrying, and dashing abilities, knowing that a good boss attack should make players move with intent, not in panic.
The Prophet was our introductory boss and a first major test for players. Because the Prophet appears early in the game, we wanted it to teach players what a Saros boss could be without becoming a major progression blocker. With the Prophet, we wanted a fight that felt dramatic and threatening while still welcoming players to the structure and expectations of boss combat.

packages.headline: Mass Effect 5 Details Revealed Following Cancellation, Including 'Hitman-Style Freedom' in Missions

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Following the cancellation of Mass Effect 5, purportedly called Mass Effect Universe, last week – alongside the closure of the entire BioWare development studio – new gameplay details about the role-playing game revival have emerged, including handcrafted missions that gave players Hitman-style freedom, the abililty to hack the environment, brutal close-range executions, the return of Liara, and much more.
Mass Effect 5 Details Revealed Following Cancellation, Including 'Hitman-Style Freedom' in Missions
Following this week's cancellation of Mass Effect 5, purportedly called Mass Effect Universe – alongside the closure of the entire BioWare development studio – new gameplay details about the role-playing game revival have emerged, including handcrafted missions that gave players Hitman-style freedom, the abililty to hack the environment, brutal close-range executions, the return of Liara, and much more.
YouTube content creator Dantics revealed the details in a new video , as he was a member of the Mass Effect Council – a group of external Mass Effect community members who gave BioWare feedback on the game during development. IGN has verified the legitimacy of these details, and can add that a development source told us that BioWare had "every major [alien] race" working in the build.
Dantics says it "looked incredible" and added , "From what I saw, BioWare was making Mass Effect for us, the fans." More specifically, he shared that the new Mass Effect was set over 600 years after the Reaper War, and your customizable agent was like a John Wick/James Bond-type character who has had experimental technology implanted in you. As a result, you'd be able to hack and manipulate the environment such as letting you "see through walls, identify systems, remotely trigger hazards, and more." Furthermore, you'd also be able to perform "brutal, close-range executions."
Meanwhile, the galaxy has been divided into three major factions, with humanity, the Krogans, the Batarians, and others allied together. The Council races formed their own alliance, while the Geth had emerged as a third superpower who constructed megastructures. Dantics describes the setting of Mass Effect Universe as "a galactic Cold War instead of another Reaper-style invasion with a shadowy adversary."
BioWare's closure and Mass Effect 5's cancellation have saddened many in the gaming community. I wrote a eulogy about how BioWare was the greatest RPG developer ever . Our own Jackie Thomas lamented that we'll never get to see the series redeemed after the disappointment of Mass Effect Andromeda, and IGN's Matt Purslow believed that EA never knew what it had with BioWare . An internal trailer leaked online following the cancellation that gives us all an idea of what BioWare was building.

packages.headline: Mass Effect Fans Call for EA Boycott as Petition to Save BioWare's Canceled Game Garners More than 75,000 Signatures

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Mass Effect fans are calling for a boycott of all EA products and services in protest of the company closing down BioWare and canceling the next Mass Effect game.
Mass Effect Fans Call for EA Boycott as Petition to Save BioWare's Canceled Game Garners More than 75,000 Signatures
It’s a rough time for Mass Effect fans. On October 21, EA announced its plans to shut down BioWare , a 30-year-old studio that spearheaded RPGs in the West with titles like Dragon Age, Jade Empire, Baldur’s Gate, and of course, Mass Effect .
In the two days since then, fans of BioWare and the Mass Effect series have gathered together to call for action, begging EA to at least sell off BioWare’s IP to other studios rather than letting them languish. In fact, tensions have become so strained that players are now calling for an outright boycott of EA’s products and services until something is done.
On Reddit, several threads are rallying Mass Effect fans to gather under the hashtag #savemasseffect, urging players to take action and make their voices heard.
“WE HAVE TO DO SOMETHING! Guys we have to start something here and cry out loud enough that this game can be saved. Either EA making it or selling it off. We have to do it now before the noise on this game quiets down and it becomes another cancelled series, never to return,” one Redditor wrote . “I suggest we start a movement, and message the hell out of EA asking for some kind of outcome that gets this game finished. THIS GAME FINISHED.”
“Mass Effect is one of the better RPGs out today,” another fan wrote in a post titled ‘EA Boycott!’ “...Unless they sell Mass Effect to another studio or bring it back. I will never buy another EA product ever. They are already not one of my favorite studios. No more Respawn Entertainment, DICE, Motive Studios, Criterion Games, Maxis, Full Circle, Cliffhanger Games, or any EA Sports.
“I hope I'm not alone in this. We need to stand up and make our voices heard. I posted on everything I can. We can't let Mass Effect die so easily. Private investors need to realize how badly EA screwed up.”
Players were eagerly awaiting news of the next game in BioWare’s beloved sci-fi franchise — but EA shut that down, too, revealing in a statement that the project was officially canceled.

sources.evidenceText:
The developers of Mass Effect-style game Exodus picked a hell of a time to reveal their redesigned male protagonist.
Mass Effect-Style Game Exodus Picked a Hell of a Time to Reveal Its Redesigned Male Protagonist
Archetype has shown off its updated character model for the male version of Exodus protagonist Jun Aslan. Prior to this, fans had complained about Jun’s “long” face, “beady eyes,” and “botox” cheeks.
“He just looks uncannily plastic surgery filled who's constantly serving his best iPhone face,” said one person at the time. “He looks like chad version of Timothee Chalamet (derogatory),” said another.
The timing of this new trailer is interesting. Players are looking at Exodus and Owlcat's The Expanse: Osiris Reborn as spiritual successors to the dormant Mass Effect series. Exodus is clearly inspired by Mass Effect, putting you in the shoes of a ship captain making tough choices across alien worlds. It also puts an emphasis on relationships with your crew, who you can bump uglies with . Indeed, former Mass Effect developers, such as lead writer Drew Karpyshyn, are working on the game.
With EA announcing Mass Effect developer BioWare’s closure and the cancelation of Mass Effect 5 this week, this Exodus announcement feels like a timely reminder that space RPGs are still very much on the menu, and BioWare lives on in spirit at other studios.
Exodus fans have picked up on this, too, with some pointing to the Jun reveal coming hot on the heels of the leaked Mass Effect 5 trailer , which suggested a Mass Effect Universe title for the canceled game. "Who is here after watching the leaked Mass Effect Universe trailer?" one Exodus fan said . "I purposely watched the Universe trailer first and Exodus last so I'd feel a little better," another said.
"Great timing Archetype!!!" one person commented. "This couldn’t have been revealed at a better time with the fallout of BioWare’s closure. The cheekbones really were the issue I think and this new, younger looking model really addresses it plainly and completely. Hopefully this satisfies the complainers who have made such a rabble about Jun’s face!"
When you play Jun Aslan, you choose whether they are male or female, with options like hairstyles, hair color, facial hair, and tattoos available to the player. Archetype has yet to reveal 'FemJun,' but did promise we'll see her soon. "We’ve got something special cooking for her reveal, and we think it’ll be worth the wait," Archetype teased.
With his makeover complete, Jun has gone full twink mode, and looks a bit like Leon Kennedy’s younger brother. The rough edges have been sanded down and now he looks like he could front a space boy band. Dem cheekbones.
Fans on Reddit seem much happier. “Not a huge fan of the default hair TBH but I can change that so all's good — the facial structure has really improved,” said one poster . “OHHHHH that is so much better. He looks like a dashing space hero instead of a bad go in the character creator, which is perfect,” said another .

Arkane Studios, which Xbox announced plans to divest in July, faces a November 13 deadline in the consultation process surrounding its proposed closure, with “several forms of takeover”…
Report: Arkane Studios has until November 13 to find a buyer [Update]
Arkane Studios , which Xbox announced plans to divest in July, faces a November 13 deadline in the consultation process surrounding its proposed closure, with “several forms of takeover” reportedly under consideration, according to French publication Le Monde .
The report, citing a union representative from Printemps Ecologique, Arkane Studios’ sole representative trade union, states that several takeover options are being considered as Microsoft seeks a partner for the studio.
The search for a buyer began in mid-summer under France’s Florange Law, which requires companies with at least 1,000 employees to seek a buyer when planning certain closures involving large-scale layoffs.
The November 13 deadline marks the end of consultations with Arkane Studios’ Social and Economic Committee. Approximately 217 jobs are at risk.
The information comes from Le Monde’s reporting and union statements, and not directly from Arkane Studios. Microsoft separately told the publication that it was “actively seeking a partner to support the next phase of development and enable the commercialization of the [ Marvel’s Blade ] project.”
Arkane Studios, also known for Dishonored and Deathloop , announced Marvel’s Blade in 2023, which a union representative told Le Monde “is nearing the end” of production. The representative said that it “would be a monumental waste” if it went unreleased, while the Syndicat des Travailleureuses du Jeu Video (French video game workers union) said it was proud of the work completed and believes the game would be a success if released.
Update 1:15 p.m.: Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, who is known for his insider reports, has added , “My understanding is that there are multiple paths actively being explored that would save Arkane Lyon . Anything can happen during negotiations, but at this point I’d be surprised if the studio is shut down.”

packages.headline: 'I Don't Know if There's Perfecting It' — Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer Chief Weighs in on Matchmaking

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Infinity Ward's Multiplayer boss weighs in on Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 matchmaking.
'I Don't Know if There's Perfecting It' — Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer Chief Weighs in on Matchmaking
The Call of Duty matchmaking debate has raged on pretty much since the beginning of multiplayer. Should matches be comprised of evenly skilled players, if there’s an accurate enough way of ensuring that? Or should skill be stripped out of the equation, so you never know what to expect from the next match?
Both sides of the argument have their valid reasons for their preference, but most recently, in 2025’s Black Ops 7, an option was presented that attempted to satisfy all. While the default matchmaking was set to skill-based, as has been the case since 2007’s game-changing Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, open matchmaking playlists were also available to those who want the opportunity to get teamed up with, and against, anybody.
This year’s Modern Warfare 4, though, has launched without that option, once again placing the matchmaking debate into the spotlight within the COD community. Is there any way to keep everyone happy, then? IGN spoke with Infinity Ward's Multiplayer creative director, Joe Cecot, who explained that match quality is the priority.
A fairly vague answer, then, and one befitting of the often-shrouded way that skill-based matchmaking (SBMM) works behind the scenes of Call of Duty matches. As previously noted, SBMM has been part of COD since the original Modern Warfare, but players only really started to feel it affecting their online experience once the algorithms were tightened from the 2019 reboot onwards.
For more on Modern Warfare 4, you can check out our review of the campaign , which will soon have multiplayer impressions added, or what we think of the extraction shooter mode, DMZ , so far.
We’ve got an in-progress Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Walkthrough to help you through the campaign missions, plus All Collectible Note Locations , and all the Code Solutions you’ll need to open every keypad and container. For multiplayer, check out How to Level Up Fast in MW4 and our Essential Multiplayer Tips and Tricks alongside the Best MW4 Settings we recommend you use. DMZ is back, so we’ve got a handy DMZ Beginner’s Guide , too.
“I don't know if there's perfecting it,” Cecot said of matchmaking. “For us, I think the most important thing when we look at matchmaking is that the matches we put together are good matches. And we're also looking at the players and their experience, and we can look at the data and how it affects things, and we can quantify how it affects a certain group of players or a large percentage of them in a negative way. And so, though we're not talking about exact specifics on matchmaking, our end goal is that every match is a good match.”

Activisionは10月23日、『Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4』（以下、CoD:
『Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4』、Steamで「非常に好評」の大盛況。新作はキャンペーンがアツい、新米兵士とプライス大尉が世界の戦場を駆けるド派手銃撃戦
Activisionは10月23日、『 Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 』（以下、CoD: MW4）を発売した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam/Microsoft Store/Battle.net）/XBOX Series X|S/PS5/Nintendo Switch 2。本作や『Call of Duty: Warzone』などを含むSteam版共通アプリ『Call of Duty』の最大同時接続プレイヤー数が約14万人を記録するなど、初日から大きな盛り上がりを見せている。
『CoD: MW4』は、現代戦を描く『Modern Warfare』シリーズの最新作だ。2023年11月に発売された『Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III』以来約3年ぶりの新作となる。本作には、ストーリーを追う「キャンペーンモード」に加え、対人戦を楽しめる「マルチプレイヤーモード」、そして脱出型PvPvEモードの「DMZ」が収録されている。
キャンペーンモードでは、北朝鮮による大規模侵攻をきっかけに、朝鮮半島で戦争が勃発。プレイヤーは初めて実戦に挑む韓国軍の若き兵士「パク二等兵」となり、仲間とともに銃弾が飛び交う死線を潜り抜けていく。一方、『Modern Warfare』シリーズでおなじみのプライス大尉は、復讐のため、独自に行動を進めているようだ。同モードでは、塹壕戦や市街戦、パリでのカーチェイスなど、世界各地を舞台とした多彩なミッションが展開される。
そしてDMZは、『Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II』ぶりに復活した、脱出型PvPvEモードだ。舞台となるのは、キャンペーンモードでの戦争によって荒廃した朝鮮半島の封鎖区域「ハジン」。プレイヤーは単独もしくは分隊で戦場に潜入し、敵兵やほかのプレイヤーと交戦しつつ、物資や軍事技術の回収を目指す。DMZでは、ストーリーミッションのほか、出撃するたびに内容が変化する任務なども存在。天候も刻々と変化していくため、遊ぶたびに異なるゲームプレイが楽しめる。また、無事に脱出できれば装備や物資が手に入る一方、脱出に失敗すればそれらすべてを失う可能性もある、シビアなゲームモードとなっている。
そんな『CoD: MW4』は、10月23日の正式発売に先駆け、10月17日より予約購入者向けにキャンペーンモードの先行アクセスを実施し、10月21日にはDMZの先行アクセスも開始していた。そしてこの度、正式発売を迎えるとさらに多くのプレイヤーが戦場に集まった。本作は『Call of Duty: Warzone』など複数のタイトルを含む共通アプリ『Call of Duty』に紐づくかたちとなっている。Steamではこちらの直近24時間の最大同時接続プレイヤー数は、本稿執筆時点で約14万2000人を記録（ SteamDB ）。この数字は『CoD: MW4』単独のものではないが、先行アクセス開始前である10月15日の最大同時接続プレイヤー数が約2万7000人だったことを踏まえると、約5.3倍となる。また、Steamユーザーレビューは約6000件中88％が好評とする「非常に好評」ステータスを獲得している。
『 Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 』はPC（ Steam / Microsoft Store / Battle.net ）/ XBOX Series X|S / PS5 / Nintendo Switch 2 向けに発売中だ。
一方、マルチプレイヤーモードには、発売時点で計20種類のマップと33種類の武器が用意されている。なかでも特殊マップの「キルブロック」は、ラウンドごとに戦場のレイアウトが変化する仕組みで、500通り以上の配置パターンが用意されている。ゲームモードも、おなじみの「チームデスマッチ」や「ドミネーション」に加え、拠点を奪い合いながら戦車などの車両も駆使して戦う大規模戦「コンバットアウトポスト」などを収録。そのほかにも、ラウンド間に獲得資金で武器や装備を購入する「コラテラル」や、倒した敵から現金を奪う「インフレーション」といった新モードも登場している。

packages.headline: 『Dead by Daylight』開発元の新レーベルMiss Behaviourは「面白いインディーホラー」を埋もれさせたくない。『DbD』パワーも惜しみなく使い、“尖ったまま”世に出す狙いを訊く

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
『Dead by Daylight』開発元のインディーゲームパブリッシングレーベル「Miss Behaviour」の理念とは。TGS会場で訊いてきた。
『Dead by Daylight』開発元の新レーベルMiss Behaviourは「面白いインディーホラー」を埋もれさせたくない。『DbD』パワーも惜しみなく使い、“尖ったまま”世に出す狙いを訊く
Nathan Sellyn氏（以下、Sellyn氏）： Miss Behaviourは、Behaviourのインディーゲームパブリッシング事業です。Behaviourが手がけているほかの事業と区別するため「Miss」を付けました。当社は35年にわたって受託開発を続けてきましたし、『Dead by Daylight』も10年目になります。今では『7 Days to Die』や『Darkest Dungeon』もありますし、数年後には『Blight: Survival』も控えています。本当にいろいろなことをやっているので、インディーゲームのパブリッシングに独自の場を設け、ほかの取り組みとはっきり区別するためにレーベルとして独立させました。
Behaviourは長い間、とても小さな会社でした。『Dead by Daylight』によって、はるかに大きな、それまでとは異なる会社へと変わり、カナダ最大のゲーム会社になりました。それはすべて、たった1本のゲームが起こした奇跡のおかげです。だからこそ、私たちに向けられた注目を小規模な開発者にも向けていく責任があると考えています。私たちが得たのと同じように、大きく飛躍するチャンスを彼らにも届けたいんです。
――ホラーゲーム中心のレーベルになったのは、やはりBehaviourが『Dead by Daylight』を手がけたスタジオであることが大きいですか。
Sellyn氏： そうですね。『Dead by Daylight』には毎月500万～600万人のプレイヤーがいます。ほかのゲームを『Dead by Daylight』と結びつけることで、それくらい多くのプレイヤーに見てもらえるわけです。それに『Dead by Daylight』を遊んでいるということは、その人たちはホラーが好きなはずですから、その人たちに面白いホラー作品を紹介してほんの一部の人にでも遊んでもらえれば、小さなゲームが軌道に乗るには十分です。私たちはそこに大きな可能性を感じていますし、社内でもかなりの盛り上がりにつながっていると思います。
Sellyn 氏： 優れたインディーパブリッシャーを見ると、特定のテーマやジャンルに特化していなくても、まさにそういう信頼を築いていますよね。私はDevolver Digital を信頼しているので、名前を見ると「これはきっと素晴らしいインディーゲームだ」と思います。Top Hat Studiosもホラーを数多く扱っていますが、ホラーとはまったく違う作品も手がけています。ジャンルが違っても、それでも彼らが作品を見極めるセンスは抜群です。私にとって、信頼できるキュレーターなんです。Miss Behaviourも、ホラー好きのプレイヤーから信頼されるキュレーターになれたら、私たちの役割をしっかり果たせたと言えると思います。 今の私たちには、『Dead by Daylight』という頼れる存在があります。これらのゲームに注目を集めるために、その力は喜んで借りていくつもりです。おそらく今後も活用し続けるでしょう。せっかく私たちが使える強みですし、ほかの誰かが使っているわけでもありませんから。ただ、いつかその力を借りなくてもやっていけるようになったら、そのときこそ、この取り組みが成功し、当初の目標を達成できたと実感できると思います。
――Behaviourは『Dead by Daylight』を通じて、ホラーを好むプレイヤーについて多くの知見を得てきたと思います。その経験は、今のホラーファンがどのようなゲームを求めているのかを考えるうえで、どの程度影響していますか？ Sellyn氏： 『Dead by Daylight』や『7 Days to Die』、そして『Darkest Dungeon』から学んだことのひとつは、ホラーゲームを遊ぶ人たちは決して一括りにはできないということです。『Dead by Daylight』のコミュニティは、本当に多様なんですよ。例えばスポーツゲームやシューターのプレイヤーは、比較的限られた範囲に収まっているのではないかと思います。一方、『Dead by Daylight』のプレイヤーは、国や地域、民族、年齢、バックグラウンドなど、あらゆる面で多様です。私たちは、その多様性をコミュニティの大切な魅力として尊重し、積極的に称えていきたいと考えています。
Behaviour Interactiveは2026年6月、新たなインディーゲームパブリッシングレーベル「Miss Behaviour」を発足した。ホラーゲームを中心にインディーゲームを支援していくという。最新タイトルとして『 Donut Panic（ドーナッても冷静に） 』が発表されている。
弊誌は「東京ゲームショウ2026」の会場で、Behaviour Interactive（以下、Behaviour）の副最高経営責任者であるNathan Sellyn氏と、Miss Behaviourがパブリッシングする『Donut Panic』の開発者であるKyle Banks氏にインタビューを実施。Behaviourがインディーゲームを支援する理念と、『Donut Panic』を応援する理由について伺った。
――Miss Behaviourとはどのようなレーベルなのか、教えていただけますか。

FGO PROJECTは10月23日、『 Fate/Grand Order（FGO） 』にてアップデートを実施した。18時より「冠位名代戦：タマモアリア」が開幕しており、19時からはレイドバトルも実施中。冠位拡張戦[エクストラ]のクリアによって、エクストラクラスの冠位サーヴァントが2騎から4騎まで指定可能になる。
『Fate/Grand Order』は、TYPE-MOONの奈須きのこ氏が総監督など、ラセングルが開発・運営を担うFateRPGだ。本作の舞台は、人類が2017年絶滅すると証明された世界。プレイヤーは人理継続保障機関カルデアに所属する人類最後のマスターとして、未来を取り戻す旅へ出発。人類史に発生した特異点や、行き止まりの人類史「異聞帯」などで、過去の英霊たちとともに壮大な戦いを繰り広げてきた。なお本作は2015年7月にリリースされ、ついに2025年12月に第二部が完結。現在は「運命の三女神編」が進行中となっている。
「 冠位名代戦：タマモアリア 」では、19時より期間限定でレイドバトルも開催。エクストラクラスだけが編成できるバトルとなっている。また「冠位名代戦」の開催にあわせて、新規サーヴァントとしてタマモアリアがライダークラスで実装。「Fate/Samurai Remnant」にて登場していた彼女が、ついに『FGO』にも登場となっている。ピックアップ召喚の開催期間は、11月11日12時59分までだ。そのほかアップデートでは、絆レベルアップ時の立ち絵が、サーヴァント詳細設定に連動するように調整されている。
『 Fate/Grand Order 』は、iOS/Android向けに配信中だ。
今回追加された「冠位名代戦」は、グランドサーヴァントで挑む新たな戦いだ。「冠位名代戦：タマモアリア」では、エクストラクラスのサーヴァントのみが編成可能となっており、最初の冠位拡張戦[エクストラ]をクリアすると、エクストラクラスのグランドサーヴァントの枠が2枠から拡張されて、4騎まで指定可能となる。本作におけるグランドサーヴァントとは、設定上は通常のサーヴァントとは異なる霊基で顕現した英霊だ。人理を守る時代最高の七騎が人類悪に対するカウンターとして召喚されるといい、メインストーリー上では冠位をもつ強力な英霊たちがグランドサーヴァントとして活躍してきた。また2025年5月には、「グランドグラフシステム」が実装。「冠位戴冠戦」のプレイによって、プレイヤーはクラスごとに好きなサーヴァントを、グランドサーヴァントに設定できるようになっていた。

スクウェア・エニックスは10月22日、『ファイナルファンタジー レゾナンス』を配信開始した。1日遅れで配信されたSteam版では最大同時接続プレイヤー数が2万人を突破し、Steamユーザーレビューは「非常に好評」ステータスを獲得するなど、さっそく人気を博している。
『FF』新作『ファイナルファンタジー レゾナンス』一日遅れのSteamでも“同接2万越”の大盛況。もしもが現実になった“ドット絵の『FF』”
スクウェア・エニックスは10月22日、『 ファイナルファンタジー レゾナンス 』を配信開始した。対応プラットフォームはPC（Steam/Microsoft Store）/Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch/PS5/XBOX Series X|Sで、Steam版のみ10月23日に配信開始している。配信前から大きな注目を集めていた本作は、Steam版の最大同時接続プレイヤー数が2万人を突破し、Steamユーザーレビューは「非常に好評」ステータスを獲得するなど、さっそく人気を博している。
『ファイナルファンタジー レゾナンス』は、『ファイナルファンタジー』シリーズ最新作だ。2025年にサービス終了したスマートフォン向けRPG『ファイナルファンタジー ブレイブエクスヴィアス』の第1シーズンをベースとし、シナリオやグラフィック、ゲームシステムなどを根本から見直したうえで、コンシューマー向けRPGとして再構築した作品となっている。ドット絵と3DCGを融合した「HD-2D」のグラフィックが特徴だ。
さらに、敵をブレイクさせたキャラクターは、ターン終了時の「エクストラフェイズ」で追加行動が可能。同一ターン内に、すべての敵をブレイクする「フルブレイク」に成功すれば、パーティメンバー全員が追加行動できるほか、強力な効果を持つビジョン固有の必殺技「レゾナンス」も発動できる。
本作は、クリスタルをめぐる物語や飛空艇、幻獣など、往年の『ファイナルファンタジー』作品を思わせる要素が随所に盛り込まれている。戦闘も昔ながらのターン制コマンドバトルをメインに据えつつ、敵をブレイク状態にして行動を封じたり、味方の追加ターンにつなげたりと、戦略性の高いバトルが楽しめる。また、ドット絵と3DCGを融合させた
『ファイナルファンタジー レゾナンス』は、PC（ Steam / Microsoft Store ）/ PS5 / XBOX Series X|S / Nintendo Switch 2 / Nintendo Switch 向けに配信中。各ストアにて デモ版 も配信中だ。

舞台となるのは、シリーズの代名詞ともいえる「クリスタル」の恩恵を受ける人々が暮らす世界。主人公は、騎士の国「グランシェルト王国」で飛空艇部隊の指揮を執る「レイン」だ。ある日、レインは国王の命を受け、仲間のラスウェルとともに、土の神殿の調査へと向かう。しかし、そこに現れた謎の男「常闇のヴェリアス」に敗れ、王国が長年にわたり守り続けてきた土のクリスタルが破壊されてしまう。世界各地に残されたクリスタルを守るため、レインとラスウェルは世界の命運をかけた冒険へと旅立つ。

packages.headline: Arkane Lyon Reportedly Could Be Closed in Mid-November if a Buyer Isn't Found, With Marvel's Blade Still in Development

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
Arkane Lyon is still working on Marvel’s Blade, but it’s doing it with the Sword of Damocles dangling over the heads of its 217 employees.
Arkane Lyon Reportedly Could Be Closed in Mid-November if a Buyer Isn't Found, With Marvel's Blade Still in Development
According to French outlet Le Monde , Florange Law, adopted in 2014 in France, requires companies with more than 1,000 employees to search for a buyer for at least three months before closing a studio. According to the report, the search for a buyer for the Dishonored 2 and Deathloop developer began in the summer, meaning the deadline is imminent — November 13.
The studio was informed of Microsoft’s decision on July 16, shortly after new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced closure or spinoff plans for Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs — Ninja Theory was closed while the other studios went independent, taking their franchises with them. Over 1,600 jobs were affected across Microsoft's gaming business at the time. More have followed, and more are set to follow still.
According to Le Monde, a union rep said that "negotiations on the redundancy plan are going badly” at Arkane Lyon, which Microsoft picked up when it bought Bethesda owner ZeniMax in 2021. The worker unions are currently trying to buy more time "to give the discussions a better chance of reaching a conclusion."
“Several forms of takeover are being considered,” according to the report, which suggests buyers are interested in the immersive sim studio. That’s why the union is pushing for more time and is “hopeful of saving the studio and its jobs.”
Microsoft didn’t respond directly to the report but sent the following statement: "We continue to explore different options for Arkane as part of the ongoing French consultation process. We are keeping the works council and employees informed and are actively seeking a partner to support the next phase of development and enable the commercialization of the project."
Negotiations are ongoing until October 30, but the union hasn’t ruled out seeing Microsoft in court. “This is in complete contradiction with what we've been told in the Works Council for years about the company's financial situation," the rep said. "Microsoft is looking to divest itself of Arkane, even though the studio is doing well, in order to save money and improve the profitability of its short-term investments."
